_comment: Static dealer data. The save keeps a dealer's Id and nothing else, so this file is the truth and is
merged over the saved dealers on load. Adding a field here reaches every existing save.
mapX/mapY are fractions of the WHOLE los_angeles_map.jpg, measured from its top left - the Automobile
Club of Southern California road map, 2444 x 1560. The screen shows a crop of it; the crop rectangle
lives in DealerMapScreenViewModel, so moving the crop does not mean moving every pin. Replacing the
map image DOES mean re-reading every pin off it, because these are fractions of that picture.
travelHours is the round trip from the garage and is meant to match the map: the lots round downtown
are an hour, the valley and the harbour two, and Riverside is most of a morning.
priceBandLow/High is the dealer's slice of the market, measured as the share of installed cars it is
dearer than - not as dollars, so it means the same thing whatever is installed. The bands overlap on
purpose; where they do, chance decides. Between them they must cover 0 to 1 or some cars have nowhere
stockLow/High is how many cars the lot carries. Keep it at or under the capacity of its showroom in
showrooms.json, or the overflow can only be read about and never seen. Bays are worked out from the
room and the number of cars, so there is nothing to author here.
